name: site-presence-brief
description: One-shot site presence brief: scrape a public URL, pull recent web context on a topic, and mint a simple Open Graph card. Mixed rails via the SELAT Router (Firecrawl scrape MPP + Perplexity search x402 + OG image x402). Paid per call, no API keys.

url.description: Public https URL to scrape (homepage or product page).

topic.description: What to search the web for — usually the brand, product, or claim on that page.

title.description: Short title for the Open Graph card (keep it under ~60 chars).

subtitle.description: Optional second line on the OG card.

recency.description: Web search recency filter: hour | day | week | month | year.
